products.name: Plasma Blast Elite Trainer Box [Genesect]
products.note: Eight packs, 40 basic Energy (5 of each of the eight types), 65 Plasma Blast sleeves, no promo (Bulbapedia merchandise page and ToyWiz, two sources). TCGplayer has no listing: price is its packs.

products.name: Plasma Blast Sleeved Booster Pack Art Bundle [Set of 4]
products.note: One sleeved pack of each of the four wrappers (TCGplayer: "Collect each of the 4 unique art packs").

products.name: Plasma Blast Three Pack Blister [Lucario]
products.note: Three packs, a coin and BW85 Lucario in Cosmos Holo (Bulbapedia merchandise page and pkmn.gg variant text).

products.name: Plasma Blast Three Pack Blister [Genesect]
products.note: Three packs, a coin and BW86 Genesect in Cosmos Holo (Bulbapedia merchandise page and pkmn.gg variant text).

products.name: Plasma Blast Single Pack Blister [Blaziken]
products.note: One pack and a Cosmos Holo reprint of Dark Explorers' Blaziken (single source; the reprint card is not simulated).

products.name: Plasma Blast Single Pack Blister [Krookodile]
products.note: One pack and a Cosmos Holo reprint of Dark Explorers' Krookodile (single source; the reprint card is not simulated).

products.name: Team Plasma Tin [Lugia-EX]
products.note: Four packs, typically two Plasma Blast, one Plasma Freeze and one Plasma Storm (Bulbapedia's merchandise page only: medium-low). The tin's code card is not simulated.
